items.title: GitHub - cerulion-inc/cerulion: Cerulion (YC S24) gives AI agents a harness to control real robots. Our open-source runtime and harness give any AI agent a physical body, inside safety limits the robot enforces, and tools to autonomously debug recorded robot failures. It's ROS 2 compatible.

items.summary: What would your AI red lines be? Write down what would make you act on AI, and what you'd do. Decide now, while it's easy to think clearly, then share it.
